description: This file defines application configuration settings for a Python backend service, including environment variable loading, data parsing, and a Settings dataclass structure with methods for initialization.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable dataclass that encapsulates configuration parameters for the application, initialized from environment variables.

methods.name: str|None _get_env(name: str, default: str | None = None)
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve environment variables with optional default.

methods.name: List[str] _parse_csv(value: str | None)
methods.description: Parses a CSV string into a list of trimmed strings.

methods.name: "Settings" from_env()
methods.description: Static method to create a Settings instance populated with environment variables.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Public function to load and return the application settings by invoking Settings.from_env().
